contributed-commands.reason: The command's only drive path is a repository quick-pick whose lenient scripted answer takes the FIRST item, which on every suite run is the workspace repository the run itself is on (workspace folders sort first) - a catalog entry would unregister the active repository mid-suite and poison every later action, and on a real repository would mark the user's repository ignored. Not honestly drivable until catalog command runs can script a specific quick-pick choice.

protocol-requests.reason: The webview's one-shot boot handshake: the host answers it with the loadView push it began reading at panel creation, never a direct reply. Replaying it mid-session would push a second merged read onto the live page for no user action - it is a lifecycle message the page itself emits exactly once, not a control a catalog entry can honestly drive.

ui-port.reason: No host call site routes through the port's withProgress yet (the only withProgress caller, commands/automation.ts's runAutomationTest, calls vscode.window.withProgress directly), so no catalog action can drive the interface member today.

ui-languages.reason: The comparison view's phone-only files bar (#mobileFilesBtn): the layout appears only with mobileAdaptation on or a phone-width window, and the E2E launcher pins the desktop layout on purpose ('git-graph-rs.mobileAdaptation': false - the touch layouts' coverage is the mobileAdaptation unit tests and the theme audit's narrow pages). The comparison-webview unit journeys drive the bar and the sheet instead.
